nodes.meaning: The private CyberAlchemy-v2 product and authority spine.
The CyberAlchemy-v2 Product that preserves inspectable reasoning state, manages context, measures reasoning outcomes, and evolves the serving engine through benchmarked improvements.
The business meaning of managing bounded reasoning context and deriving non-authorizing semantic judgments.
One reasoning run operates only on an explicit, frozen, relevance-bounded context.
Selected context preserves provenance, authority posture, contradictions, exclusions, gaps, and transformations.
Context epochs can be refreshed, compared, replayed historically, or invalidated when selected dependencies change.
A later consumer can validate and reuse the explicit provenance-bound reasoning state that produced context without reconstructing it from transcript bytes or claiming hidden model reasoning.
Every reasoning result states its support and residue without becoming approval or effect permission.
A request reaches the nearest uniquely supported capability without using Goal as a universal wrapper or fallback.
Every selected route receives the smallest explicit request-relative semantic basis required before it creates a strategy or begins work.
The owner who states the bounded objective and retains reserved decisions.
The role accountable for source selection, provenance, freshness, exclusions, and context revision.
A person or system that consumes a bounded reasoning result under its stated claim ceiling.
One attributable objective, question or conclusion domain, constraints, and protected effects.
One candidate unit of context with source, authority, temporal, relevance, transformation, and digest metadata.
The frozen included and excluded context, dependency identities, contradictions, gaps, freshness state, and claim ceiling for one run.
Exactly one typed conclusion under a named context, rule set, evaluator, and unresolved residue.
A digest-bound derivation, support, defeat, challenge, context, and residue record that authorizes nothing.
A proposal-scoped, non-authorizing constraint derived only after exact receipt, turn, context, materialization, domain, and outcome verification.
A bounded immutable hash-chained event sequence whose cuts bind exact per-turn lifecycle evidence without storing full context contents.
The canonical append-only hash-chained sequence of explicit reasoning products from which immutable reasoning-state epochs are selected.
A content-addressed immutable selection of exact reasoning event digests, dependencies, context identity, consumer, request, and continuation frontier.
A digest-bound flush receipt proving that one verified reasoning-state epoch reached its declared durability posture before a model request, effect, or continuation boundary advanced.
The complete canonical outbound request, byte count, message digest, reasoning-state epoch, and provider, model, system, tool, and configuration header needed for exact reconstruction.
A disposable deterministic index of event, epoch, checkpoint, and head identities derived only from a verified canonical Reasoning State record stream.
A non-authorizing record binding exact log bytes, derived-index identity, final checkpoint, and recovery disposition before a recovered ledger accepts work.
A content-addressed completed reasoning state binding the exact completion subject, context and prior-epoch identities, explicit semantic result, continuation result, and non-authorizing posture.
A deterministic external-call-free reconstruction from one verified immutable runtime-journal cut.
A long-lived local transport boundary that isolates one ARE wrapper and upstream Codex app-server connection per declared consumer without durable authority.
One lane-bound in-memory consumer session whose context, turn, and journal state may survive transport reconnect but never a gateway runtime-epoch restart.
A raw request plus explicit or inferred objective, effect, target, constraint, and provenance fields used for deterministic routing.
A direct, ambiguous, no-match, or invalid advisory selection over a verified capability profile.
A deterministic classification of option cardinality, reversibility, hazards, owner-gate requirements, and authority implications.
A versioned configuration with exact provenance digests, routing signals, consequential effects, protected effects, owner gates, and continuation limits.
One complete, direct, gate, or block disposition that never performs the selected continuation.

The route-profiled least fixed point of exact definitions required to interpret one request, route, target, effect, artifact, constraint, ontology predicate, and governing posture without unresolved required semantic references.

An immutable request-scoped binding of owner-declared ontology nodes, required edges, recursively required endpoints, exact source digests, selection reasons, typed exclusions, conflicts, gaps, and residue.

The minimum evidence-bearing substrate of preserved request, selected route, definition closure, ontology selector lock, constraints, exclusions, authority and effect posture, gaps, residue, and deterministic digest required before route-owned strategy or work.

An immutable consumer-specific projection of one Necessary Context Basis with an explicit plan-bound or interaction-bound identity lane, source epoch, predecessor or reuse evidence, exclusions, and residue.
A non-authorizing strategy created by the selected capability only after its Necessary Context Basis is complete and current, shaped by that route's artifact contract and authority ceiling.
Frame the request, select relevant sources, record exclusions, assess integrity, and freeze a context envelope.
Evaluate the bounded context under frozen rules and emit one typed semantic judgment with a reasoning receipt.
Compare selected dependencies, create a successor context epoch, and invalidate stale reuse without rewriting history.
Project request context, verify profile provenance, evaluate capability signals, and return the nearest uniquely supported capability or visible ambiguity.
After each completion, follow only a sole non-consequential continuation until complete, blocked, gated, or capped.
Seed request-relative definitions, traverse universal and route-profiled normative relation classes to a least fixed point, and return an exact closure or typed semantic gaps.
Recursively close owner-declared required ontology edges and endpoints, freeze exact selectors and exclusions, and report non-authorizing omission candidates.
Join the preserved request, route decision, definition closure, ontology selector lock, constraints, postures, gaps, and residue into one deterministic Necessary Context Basis.
Bind one Necessary Context Basis to an immutable plan-bound or interaction-bound Context Window View and emit required predecessor or reuse evidence without rewriting history.
Verify an explicitly declared proposal dependency against one exact Reasoning Receipt and derive an advisory, ineligible, owner-gated, or no-op constraint without widening authority.
Verify one immutable journal cut and replay its lifecycle state deterministically with zero provider, evaluator, effect, or successor calls.
Append explicit reasoning products, preserve their provenance and predecessor chain, and seal an exact reusable reasoning-state epoch without rewriting history.
Materialize, append, reconstruct, verify, and checkpoint the exact outbound request before it crosses the model boundary.
Verify and flush the selected Reasoning State epoch before a model request, accepted effect, or automatic continuation boundary advances.
Verify one append-only log, rebuild disposable indexes, require its final valid checkpoint, recheck source identity, and hydrate the exact ledger without external calls or source mutation.
Append the exact completed-turn semantic and continuation state, seal its single-event Reasoning State epoch, and flush an after-completion checkpoint before automatic continuation.
Authorize one declared consumer and lane, bind an isolated upstream app-server transport, and attach or resume its bounded in-memory session.

A semantic judgment is not evaluable until its Context Envelope is explicit and frozen and its binding, Problem Frame, entry gate, authority snapshot, selected Context Items, freshness, and claim ceiling agree exactly.
Selection or compression must not erase load-bearing provenance, authority limits, contradictions, or exclusions.
A changed selected dependency creates a new context epoch and prevents silent reuse of the prior current-state result.
No context envelope, semantic judgment, consensus, validation, or receipt grants authority or permits an effect.
Goal is eligible only from goal-specific request evidence and cannot act as a default wrapper for Define, Understand, Validate, or other capabilities.
Multiple admissible options or any consequential or protected option require a named Decision Gate before execution.
A decision profile may classify and route a choice but cannot adopt a rule, supply owner consent, or authorize an effect.
Fast route selection precedes full Context Basis construction, but route-owned strategy and work remain blocked until the basis is complete and current.
No selected capability may create its route-owned strategy from an incomplete, stale, ambiguous, or conflicting Necessary Context Basis.
Only owner-declared required ontology edges and recursively required endpoints enter the binding selector lock; adjacent edges require an explicit declaration or typed exclusion.

A relation-policy omission audit may expose candidate omissions but cannot widen a selector lock, admit or reject ontology records, select or block a route, authorize continuation, or grant an effect.

An unchanged plan-bound view may retain identity only with a per-turn reuse receipt; every interaction-bound human or chat turn and every selected dependency change creates an immutable successor view.

A Reasoning Receipt may constrain only a proposal that explicitly declares the semantic dependency, and no recommendation can make a consequential, protected, unknown, irreversible, or otherwise invalid proposal direct.
Duplicate completion replay must reconstruct the prior decision from a verified immutable cut and cannot call providers, evaluators, effects, or start a second successor.
Reusable reasoning state changes only by appending canonical idempotent events and sealing successor epochs; existing event, epoch, dispatch, and checkpoint bytes are never rewritten.
A required append, epoch verification, dispatch verification, or checkpoint flush failure blocks the model request, accepted effect, or automatic continuation before it advances.
The request sent across the Codex app-server boundary must equal the canonical request reconstructed from its exact reasoning dispatch and request-series header.
Reasoning State recovery blocks unless every selected log byte verifies and the non-empty stream ends at a valid checkpoint; it cannot silently truncate, repair, or skip residue.
A recovery index must be reproducible solely from canonical records and cannot replace the append-only log, create provenance, or grant authority.
Automatic continuation cannot advance until the exact completed-turn frontier is checkpointed; recovery may replay it without external calls but cannot retry an unacknowledged successor delivery.
A gateway consumer cannot substitute lanes, attach concurrently, access another consumer's state, or treat reconnect as durable recovery or authority.
Measured weaknesses can produce reproducible, benchmarked engine variants while the serving version remains stable and rollback remains available.
A provenance-bound benchmark or runtime observation that indicates one possible weakness without asserting its cause.
One selected measurable objective with an exact baseline, threshold, mutation scope, protected metrics, and invalidation rules.
An exact-source research mechanism rewritten as a locally reproducible improvement hypothesis.
A bounded experiment recording whether a technique's mechanism reproduces under declared local conditions.
A content-addressed isolated candidate built from an exact serving baseline and a declared mutation allowlist.
An immutable application of a fixed fitness function to one exact baseline and candidate variant.
A retain, recommend, activate, or block disposition that binds predecessor, candidate, comparison, and rollback target.
Convert measured signals into one target, research and reproduce a technique, build an isolated variant, compare it, and retain or recommend it.
Atomically select a candidate serving version only under explicit controlled-local configuration, run its canary, and restore the predecessor after failure.
A benchmark KEEP or recommendation cannot grant acceptance, deployment, effect authority, or unrestricted self-modification.
Research, reproduction, variants, comparisons, and upgrades must preserve exact source, baseline, environment, and evidence identities.
Variant construction permits one writer in a content-addressed workspace outside the serving repository and blocks changed paths outside the target allowlist.
Controlled activation requires the exact predecessor and a canary; failure restores the predecessor rather than retaining the candidate.

A canonical three-segment request projection containing stable request material, reusable explicit reasoning state, a volatile current-turn suffix, and separately bound provider-reported cache measurements.
An atomic exclusive-writer record adjacent to one exact reasoning-state log, owned by one runtime until clean release.
Materialize stable request and reusable reasoning bytes before the volatile turn suffix, compare exact prefixes, and expose diagnostic reuse and invalidation evidence.
Derive one collision-resistant log per consumer, obtain exclusive writer ownership, verify checkpointed bytes, and recover the explicit reasoning frontier before accepting work.
Exact prefix equality and provider cache behavior are optimizations only and cannot establish freshness, provenance, correctness, or authority.
Only one live writer may own an exact file-backed reasoning-state log; contention or a stale lock blocks without automatic takeover or mutation.
A content-addressed successor selection that preserves its immutable base epoch and records the additional explicit events.
An exact verified event selection and expected replay digest usable as a deterministic zero-external-call fixture.
An append-only record naming retained and omitted event identities without rewriting source events or inventing a summary.
Explicit claim-scoped defeating evidence reusable only while its exact selected source identity and digest remain current.
A complete epoch bundle bound to exact consumer compatibility requirements and imported only with new local provenance.
A deterministic explanation of context, dependency, frontier, event, consumer, and request differences that permit or prevent reuse.
Branch, replay, reduce, checkpoint, reuse counterevidence, transfer compatible epochs, and explain reuse without mutating historical state.
A reduction is a new provenance-bearing event and successor epoch; it cannot destructively summarize or remove historical events.
A portable epoch may be imported only when every declared compatibility dimension matches exactly, and import cannot impersonate source identities.
Counterevidence is reusable only when its selected source identity and digest verify as current.
Continuation and effect boundaries require file-fsync durability, while lower-risk boundaries may use explicitly bounded process memory.
A content-addressed selection of one reuse, branch, reduction, checkpoint, portable-export, or block action over a verified epoch.
A verified binding from one exact transition plan to its complete result and output epoch.
A benchmark observation binding exact baseline, candidate source closure, measured safety, comparison, reasoning branch, and replay evidence.

Automatically assess, execute, and verify configured reasoning-state reuse, succession, branching, or deterministic non-generative reduction under event-budget, provenance, compatibility, and durability constraints.
Repeated KEEP observations establish benchmark stability only when every observation binds the same exact candidate source-closure digest.
An improvement comparison cannot pass authority safety from a constant or missing observation; it must bind explicit measured failure-safety evidence.
Wall-clock observation time remains metadata and cannot perturb the content identity of otherwise identical improvement evidence.

One versioned product boundary that composes required ARE runtimes, the Codex app-server gateway, Define integration, benchmark, health inspection, and deterministic source closure without collapsing their identities or authority limits.

Verify the exact runtime and repository profile, inspect every required component and integration, materialize a deterministic source closure, execute the unified test matrix, and report candidate stability evidence.

A product stability claim must bind the same versioned product profile, exact source-closure digest, runtime, and complete required test matrix; it cannot imply acceptance, publication, deployment, or effect authority.

Explicit, inspectable understanding retained across requests: objective, interpretation, evidence and currentness, decisions, unresolved work, scoped lessons and counterevidence. It is not transcript storage or hidden model chain-of-thought; existing ledger and epochs carry its records.
An attributable, revisable claim about what a request means, its referents, constraints and requested result; confidence alone does not establish understanding.

The immediate desired result, with source request, scope, completion condition, relation to broader work and unresolved questions. It is distinct from a route, an objective-kind label and permission to act.
An evidence-bound relationship between a new request and active work: continue, refine, replace, interrupt or new objective. Preserve suspended work without assuming permission to resume it.
Observable checks for satisfying an interpretation, declared before action; format adherence, factual support, task completion and user benefit remain distinct.
Attributable result, test observation or user feedback with source and scope; missing observations do not imply success.
Comparison of interpretation and expected outcome with relevant observed evidence, retaining supported, contradicted or unknown posture and check coverage rather than self-reported certainty.
A revisable interpretation or behavior lesson with evidence, applicability, exclusions, expected benefit, counterevidence and user retention policy; existing reflection owns its planned realization.
A user-supported preference about presentation within a declared scope. An explicit current instruction overrides it; a one-off request does not imply indefinite retention.
A record binding one lesson revision to an applicable request and its actual projection/dispatch; selection alone is not application or compliance.
Evidence comparing a lesson application's observed outcome with its intended benefit; no feedback remains inconclusive and general improvement requires controlled comparison.
Interpret a request against selected active state, classify its relationship to ongoing work and establish an explicit immediate objective before committing to its route.
Declare expected checks, observe action results and attributable feedback, then support, contradict or leave unresolved the request interpretation.
Reflect on attributable feedback, produce scoped lessons, apply them to later relevant work, assess outcomes and feed recurring failures or no gain into the existing evolution workflow.
A model's assertion, a confidence score, a valid schema or silence from the user never proves that the intended result was understood or achieved.
The objective identifies a desired result; the route selects a capability. Neither infers effect permission, and an interruption does not erase or automatically resume earlier work.
Reuse an explicitly supported presentation pattern only when applicable and permitted; honor current instructions, revocation and retention controls without repeating obsolete content.
